{{Quote|Grandma Drake's soup recipes shall never fall into the hands of the Empire. HA HA! It was a test, you see, and you have done well. You have earned my trust.|[[Garek]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:HtA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Helping the Alliance|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
'''Drake''', best known as '''Grandma Drake''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] who was famous for her cooking recipes during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Garek]] once stored Grandma Drake's soup recipes on several [[Datacard/Legends|datadisks]] and ordered new recruits to retrieve them as a loyalty test.<ref name="SWG:HtA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grandma Drake was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HtA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Grandma Drake was mentioned during the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:HtA" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
